base_url.label: Server URL
base_url.description: Ntfy Instance URL. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

update_notification.label: Update Notification
update_notification.description: Replace a notification already sent (or still scheduled) with new content, e.g. a progress update. Fields left empty are not copied from the original. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.

sequence_id.label: Sequence ID
sequence_id.description: The notification to replace: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.

message.label: Message
message.description: The new notification body, up to 4,096 bytes, e.g. "Download 50% done".

title.label: Title
title.description: Optional notification title, e.g. "Backup finished". Defaults to the topic URL in the apps.

priority.label: Priority
priority.description: How urgently the phone should alert. Leave empty for the default (3).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags shown with the notification. Tags that match an emoji short code (e.g. warning, white_check_mark, rotating_light) are shown as that emoji.

click.label: Click URL
click.description: Web page or app link opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. https://example.com/orders/42

icon.label: Icon URL
icon.description: URL of a JPEG or PNG image used as the notification icon, e.g. https://example.com/icon.png

attach.label: Attachment URL
attach.description: Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf. ntfy does not download it; the apps link to it.

filename.label: Attachment File Name
filename.description: Name shown for the attachment, e.g. report.pdf. Only used together with an attachment.

markdown.label: Markdown
markdown.description: Render the message as Markdown (supported in the web app and on Android).

actions.label: Action Buttons
actions.description: Up to 3 buttons as a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"view","label":"Open","url":"https://example.com"}]. Types: view, http, broadcast, copy. See https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons

delay.label: Delay
delay.description: Schedule delivery for later: a duration (30m, 2h, 1 day), a Unix timestamp or natural language like 'tomorrow, 10am'. Between 10 seconds and 3 days on default servers.

clear_notification.label: Clear Notification
clear_notification.description: Mark a notification as read and dismiss it from phones and the web app. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.

sequence_id.label: Sequence ID
sequence_id.description: The notification to clear: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.

delete_notification.label: Delete Notification
delete_notification.description: Remove a notification from phones and the web app, or cancel a scheduled one before it is delivered. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.

sequence_id.label: Sequence ID
sequence_id.description: The notification to delete or cancel: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. reminder-42.

list_scheduled_messages.label: List Scheduled Messages
list_scheduled_messages.description: List messages that are scheduled for later delivery and have not been delivered yet. A message scheduled a few seconds ago may not be listed yet.

topics.label: Topics
topics.description: One topic, or several separated by commas, e.g. alerts,backups_home. Letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
